schedule: Separately predeclared follow-up after the original screen lacked eligible high-concurrency samples: two batch64 screens, one warmup and two scored rounds per arm with balanced rotated order, 30 seconds initial cooldown and 5 seconds between invocations. No score-selected replacement runs.
ranking: Highest eligible throughput within this follow-up for each exact binary and workload; p99 and grouping counts come from the same invocation. Do not hide or replace the original cohort.

stall_filter.selection: Flag each run independently using mean timings; a passing mean does not exclude brief SSD stalls.

constraints: Do not modify grouping, FRONTIER, sync, or wire code.
Do not infer full performance qualification from a batch-only screen.
All scratch databases are inside the local repository and only run-owned databases are removed.
The SSD showed stalls in previous captures; preserve and flag all samples.
